hello, there was the start of a big feature the other day that i am not coming around to review, and as it stands, I think the whole thing is kinda broken, but i dont know the best way to explain it other than just giving you a flow of what happens. so, here it is. In cart/editor i click on the file menu for Globals -> Animation, this opens a new tab in the app with one side of it being a web camera tracking view, and the other side is a player model, that is suppose to update its animation state by tracking the user from their webcam.  and then, the app itself starts to become unresponsive. I cant close it properly, i cant navigate to any other feature in the app, and to actually close the window i do have to run a kill -9 command on the process.

events.text: Root cause confirmed: Globals → Animation calls MoveNet synchronously through __pose_estimate from a React timer. The reported ~63ms jsTick is ONNX inference monopolizing the sole V8/UI thread; ORT /sys/class/drm lines are warning noise and the one-time foliage allocation is a separate WorldLoader mount. Fixing at the Zig boundary with a bounded worker + async completion, owned camera snapshots, and unmount cancellation.

resolution: Fixed the Globals to Animation lockup at its root: MoveNet inference no longer runs synchronously inside the V8 UI tick. Live camera frames now cross a bounded, owned-snapshot Zig worker boundary, results return through correlated FFI events, and tab cleanup cancels listeners without waiting. The CPU-only ONNX session suppresses irrelevant DRM discovery warnings while retaining explicit errors. Added mailbox, bridge, ONNX integration, shutdown, and optional sustained frame-gate coverage; the 60-second gate completed 667 requests with 0.951 ms average and 1.160 ms worst submission time and zero frame-budget spikes.
